# Callouts: Flash backup 10.1 - U7's two cJTAG test points, and the pins they ring to

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~104 px/mm in this crop)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb10-1_cooker-u7-cjtag.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb10-1_cooker-u7-cjtag.jpg)

TP13 carries U7's TMSC (pin 24), TP14 its TCKC (pin 25): the XDS110's TMS and TCK go there and nowhere else on U7; its GND goes to JP5 pin 2 (picture 7.1). The beeper checks each pair first (dotted). U7 sits turned 180 degrees: its pin-1 dot is bottom right, so pins 24 and 25 meet at the top-left corner.
